title: Qwen3-VL production-tool oracle trajectory reachability pilot
purpose: Before constructing a new training iteration, test whether unchanged production tools and hard gates can realize replayable trajectories that reach a preregistered change-mask endpoint within the production max_steps=3 budget on parent-isolated LEVIR train/validation crops.

anchors.freeze_commit_recording_policy: The in-commit config records implementation A only and keeps pilot_freeze_commit null to avoid self-reference. The external append-only manifest and receipts record both A and exact freeze B. B must be A's direct child and must change exactly this config plus the 0803 oracle-trajectory document.
anchors.pending_anchor_policy: Pilot implementation A and freeze B must be materialized and bound by an exact-B zero-GPU validation receipt before any formal pilot submission.

scope_and_interpretation.limitation: All six crops were already manually inspected during 0801 curation. This is a non-blinded feasibility pilot, not an unbiased LEVIR-CD estimate and not evidence that Qwen can choose the oracle actions.

provenance.semantic_policy: Reuse only the physical RGB descriptions recorded in 0801. The descriptions may establish broad building/background temporal semantics, but they are not pixel-perfect labels and may not replace offline GT scoring.
provenance.selection_bias: The six samples were deliberately selected from previously reviewed 0801 cases to cover changed/unchanged and both temporal directions; selection is therefore provisional and non-blinded.

parent_split_isolation.derivation_policy: Train episodes may only produce train C-ISO/T-TRAJ records; validation episodes remain held out and may only produce validation records.

semantic.rgb_evidence: T1 shows cultivated ground while T2 shows a newly built roofed house at the same location.
T1 shows trees and bare ground while T2 shows roofed buildings in the same area.
The same roofed residential buildings remain visible in both T1 and T2.
T1 shows grass and trees while T2 shows a roofed house at the same location.
T1 shows a small light-roofed building while T2 shows grass at the same location.
Both T1 and T2 show open fields without a roofed building in the inspected area.

execution_protocol.initialization: fresh production SAM3 initialization from each 256x256 A/B crop
execution_protocol.point_tool: real SimpleClick through the production subprocess adapter
execution_protocol.box_tool: real SAM3 box segmentation through the production OmniOVCD path
execution_protocol.selected_action_replay: Every oracle-selected branch action is immediately executed again by the single canonical max_steps=3 Environment from its current accepted state; branch and canonical T1/T2/change mask hashes must match before state carryover.
execution_protocol.live_proposals: After every accepted candidate, use the Environment-refreshed full live proposal catalog; candidate delta d* proposals are evidence-only and cannot authorize the next action.

production_action_mapping.scope: Frozen useful executor-reachable policy over Environment-owned geometry; this is broader than the current deterministic StagedQwenVerifier planner and is not claimed to be every mathematically possible tool call.

non_delta_proposal.positive_point: At component_seed_pixels on both target views; this can add a black-seed object or refine/expand an already-white object.
non_delta_proposal.negative_point: At component_seed_pixels only on target views whose live seed is white; the production Executor rejects a black clicked component.
non_delta_proposal.box: At the exact proposal box on both target views.
non_delta_proposal.rgb_filter_before_top4: The provisional RGB direction gate removes physically inconsistent action/target pairs before ranking the execution shortlist.

production_action_mapping.scan: Enumerate positive_point at the scan seed and box at box_pixels on t1 then t2; negative_point is unavailable because both live scan seeds are black.
production_action_mapping.delta_added_or_removed: candidate-verification evidence only; never a next-live action source
production_action_mapping.p2_bias_correction: Frozen P2 counted only the white-side negative point as planner-primary. This independent tool-reachability gate also evaluates black-side positive, same-side positive refinement, proposal boxes, and scan positive points without rewriting P2.
production_action_mapping.enumeration_order: Environment proposal order, then the action/target order defined above

candidate_and_replay_budget.catalog_policy: Enumerate the complete frozen useful-executor policy over the current live Environment proposal catalog before opening GT; this excludes artificial geometry and candidate-delta proposals and is not claimed to exhaust every mathematically callable tool input.
candidate_and_replay_budget.offline_shortlist_policy: After catalog completion, discard RGB-incompatible actions and rank the remainder by descending current change-error pixels inside the Environment proposal box, then lexicographic action identity; execute the first four.
candidate_and_replay_budget.budget_hit_definition: A catalog action selected into the frozen top-four oracle shortlist, a selected candidate execution, or a selected-action replay cannot be executed because the corresponding cap would be exceeded. Catalog actions outside the frozen shortlist are a declared policy limitation, not a runtime budget hit.

gt_boundary.selector_input: Candidate-mask metrics recomputed against the frozen crop label, unchanged hard-gate decisions, and the provisional RGB semantic contract only. Candidate-state hashes bind the evidence but are not ranking signals. Canonical replay occurs only after selection and is not a selector input.
gt_boundary.selection_order: Among executed shortlisted candidates: lowest pixel error, then highest IoU, then highest F1, then lexicographically smallest action identity.
gt_boundary.selected_state_handoff: Only the canonical Environment state produced by replaying the selected action is carried into the next step; the label, metrics, and GT-derived hints are never passed to proposals, tools, hard gates, or a model.

already_endpoint.definition: initial mask is not exact but already satisfies the absolute endpoint
already_endpoint.historical_initialization_check: All six frozen 0801 initial masks are below the endpoint, so this status is only a fail-closed guard against runtime drift.

per_step_requirements.nonempty_gt: IoU and F1 must each strictly increase at every accepted step.
per_step_requirements.empty_gt: FP must strictly decrease at every accepted step.

endpoint_success.nonempty_f1_role: Redundant consistency check: for one binary mask F1=2*IoU/(1+IoU), so IoU>=0.90 implies F1>=18/19.
endpoint_success.empty_gt_iou_f1_note: For an empty GT, IoU/F1 remain zero until exact empty and therefore cannot define a useful near-endpoint; use the preregistered FP residual instead.

metric_and_success_contract.scientific_scope: Change-mask endpoint reachability within three steps under this six-crop, frozen top-4 greedy oracle policy only. Failure does not prove that the full action space or a longer max_steps budget is unreachable.

data_derivation_contract.t_traj: One linked audit -> action -> candidate -> accepted next-state sequence containing every accepted step from the endpoint-success episode.
data_derivation_contract.c_iso: One isolated stage record per accepted transition, mechanically derived from the exact same T-TRAJ episode and state hashes.
data_derivation_contract.split_inheritance: Derived records inherit the source parent split and are written to physically separate train/ and val/ JSONL paths; validation records cannot enter training.
data_derivation_contract.artifact_level: Canonical replayable trajectory-source corpus with RGB parent/crop, state-mask, proposal, tool, gate, metric, and lineage references. It is not yet a Qwen ShareGPT conversation and requires a later deterministic formatting stage before SFT.
data_derivation_contract.matched_comparison_requirement: C-ISO and T-TRAJ must share source parents and accepted transitions; later training must match base checkpoint, token exposure or optimizer steps, and evaluation protocol.

qwen_base_model_disabled.runtime_validation: Confirm zero model loads and zero Qwen calls from receipts.

independent_post_generation_validation.dependency: afterany on all three end-to-end generation shards so the finalizer always emits a terminal status and QQ notification; scientific validation proceeds only if all three completion markers pass.

resource_plan.round_dag: Three one-GPU shard jobs each process two samples end-to-end. Within each step: freeze the complete GT-free catalog; use GT offline only to select the top-4 execution shortlist; run all shortlisted real-tool candidates without GT; use GT offline only to rank the completed candidates; replay the selected action in the canonical Environment. One dependent zero-GPU job independently recomputes metrics, validates receipts, and derives matched data.

artifact_plan.attempt_policy: append-only first-absent attempt-NNNN; never overwrite or combine partial attempts; contract and submission failures remain in diagnostics, while an unsubmitted formal reservation is atomically relocated out of formal outputs
required_per_step_evidence: parent state T1/T2/change raw and semantic hashes
live proposal catalog and deterministic action inventory
all generated candidate masks and tool evidence
complete live action-catalog marker written before first GT access
complete shortlisted real-tool candidate batch and offline selection receipt
accepted state hash and deterministic selected-action replay receipt
